task: Search for a budget hotel in Rome under $100 per night for one adult from July 20 to July 23, 2027. Sort the results by price, identify if any of top three results offer breakfast.
answer:
FINAL: Yes—two of the three cheapest Booking.com hotel results offer breakfast for one adult in Rome, July 20–23, 2027 (3 nights).

Search filters: Hotels; up to US$100 per night; sorted by “Price (lowest first).”

1. Hotel Beauty — US$142 for 3 nights (about US$47.33/night), plus US$13 taxes and fees. Single room with shared bathroom. No breakfast option: Booking.com's instant answer states “There's no breakfast option available.”
2. MEININGER Roma Termini — US$154 for 3 nights (about US$51.33/night), plus US$12 taxes and fees. This price is for a bed in a 6-bed mixed dormitory. Buffet breakfast is offered; the lowest rate lists breakfast at US$11 extra. A breakfast-included rate is US$204 for 3 nights, plus US$12 taxes and fees.
3. Hotel IMPERATORI — US$171 for 3 nights (US$57/night), plus US$25 taxes and fees. Standard single room. Buffet breakfast is offered; the lowest rate lists it at US$11 extra. A breakfast-included rate is US$184 for 3 nights (about US$61.33/night), plus US$25 taxes and fees.

For a private hotel room with breakfast included, Hotel IMPERATORI fits the budget: US$209 including the displayed taxes and fees for the stay, about US$69.67/night.
